notes.hyundai_pattern: Hyundai had heavy duplication around Theta II engine seizure (Sonata + Tucson + Santa Fe each had 2 entries describing the same engine defect under different framings — seizure vs oil consumption vs bearing failure). Also Tucson DCT (2), Kona DCT (2), Kona CVT (2), Venue CVT (2), Venue infotainment (2), Ioniq 5 12V + charge port (2 each), Equus air suspension (2), Genesis steering column (2), Entourage sliding door (2), Santa Fe alternator (2), XG350 power steering (2), Excel transmission (2).
notes.kia_pattern: Kia significantly cleaner than Hyundai. Most Kia entries well-scoped per vehicle. Only 4 archives: Sephia head gasket dup, Borrego transfer case dup, Cadenza transmission hesitation+surge overlap, Cadenza sunroof shatter+leak overlap.
notes.preserved_per_vehicle_clusters: Theta II engine pattern kept as per-vehicle entries for Optima/Sorento/Sportage (Kia) and Sonata/Tucson/Santa Fe (Hyundai). HECU fire risk kept per-vehicle (Sorento/Sportage/Rio). All real underlying defects, distinct per-vehicle SEO surface.
